entries.title: Psalms 112:1
segments: Praise the LORD! Blessed [is] the man who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in His commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 112:2
segments: His seed shall be mighty on earth; the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

entries.title: Psalms 112:3
segments: Wealth and riches [shall be] in his house, and his righteousness stands forever.

entries.title: Psalms 112:4
segments: To the upright there arises light in the darkness; [he is] gracious and full of pity and righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 112:5
segments: A good man shows favor, and lends; he will guide his business with fairness.

entries.title: Psalms 112:6
segments: Surely he shall not be moved forever; the righteous shall be remembered forever.

entries.title: Psalms 112:7
segments: He shall not be afraid of bad news; his heart [is] fixed, trusting in the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 112:8
segments: His heart [is] sure; he shall not be afraid [though] he sees his oppressors.

entries.title: Psalms 112:9
segments: He has scattered abroad; he has given to the poor; his righteousness [endures] forever; his horn shall be lifted up with honor.

entries.title: Psalms 112:10
segments: The wicked shall see and be vexed; he shall gnash with his teeth and melt away; the desire of the wicked shall perish.
